theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tpf_blowUp_limit_boundaryVanishes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → BoundaryVanishes T → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T x (lams i) (hlams i).ne') C → BoundaryVanishes C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
